_comment: Machine-readable twin of REPORT.md section 11, 'every number, by regime'.
Only the historical regimes live here: those runs are no longer
reproducible (the eval sets and scoring rules changed under them), so the
numbers are transcribed rather than measured. The entity-normalisation
arms are NOT here -- mapping_dashboard.py parses those from the
validation_report_*.md files they were written to, so they cannot drift.
check_mapping_results.py verifies every figure below still appears in
REPORT.md, so a correction there fails loudly here instead of silently
leaving two versions of the truth.
rule: Do not rank across regimes. Each regime has its own eval set, denominator and scoring rules; a number is only comparable to others inside its own panel.

consequences: supervised_classifier and knn_corpus share one corpus, so anything wrong with the corpus is wrong with both at once.
declared and the extractor both depend on emerging-all.rules, which is gitignored - its absence degrades two sources at once, silently.
canonicalize() is the one chokepoint both corpus and query pass through, which makes the entity tagger a switch over the whole system rather than a query-time filter.

glossary.claimed: A resolver *claims* an evaluation signature when it is the first in the chain to produce any candidate at all. The chain is strictly first-match-wins: if declared returns something, nothing below it runs for that signature. So the count is how many signatures every higher source drew a blank on, and the percentage is how often this one was right on exactly those.
glossary.corpus row: One labelled rule text in a training corpus. Unrelated to the evaluation signatures above: corpus rows are what the classifier trains on and kNN retrieves against.

pipeline.provenance_warning: These percentages are NOT one run. The cascade itself is structural, but each accuracy comes from the effort and regime marked on its box: the source layers are effort 9 at scale (regime C, 397 scoreable), and the kNN figure is effort 19 (regime D, 361 scoreable, best retrieval source). Read each box against its own regime panel below, never against its neighbours.
